spec.behavior: Prepare a real length-4096 impulse with one followed by 4095 zeros, compute its forward unnormalized FFT, materialize the interleaved real/imaginary spectrum as 8192 scalars, check every complex output against 1+0i within absolute tolerance 1e-9, and print the validation receipt.
spec.transform: forward unnormalized radix-2 FFT; output order is [real(0), imag(0), real(1), imag(1), ...]
spec.allocation: Every rail allocates/materializes the 4096-scalar input, the N-point complex spectrum, and the 8192-scalar interleaved output before checking all 4096 complex values.
spec.tolerance: absolute error <= 1e-9 independently for every real and imaginary scalar

jet.author: FftCell
jet.notes: Builds the 4096-point impulse with compute.zeros and one compute.set, calls shipped core.compute.fft, materializes the interleaved spectrum with compute.to_list, and checks every pair against the documented tolerance.

rust.author: FftCell
rust.notes: Std-only iterative radix-2 FFT; allocates the input, complex spectrum, and 8192-scalar interleaved output before checking every pair. Validation commands were intentionally not run.

python.author: FftCell
python.notes: Uses preinstalled NumPy np.fft.fft as the Python incumbent, then materializes an 8192-scalar interleaved output and checks every pair. NumPy availability was not probed in this source-only phase; no dependency was installed.

c.author: FftCell
c.notes: Stdlib-only iterative radix-2 FFT with explicit input, complex spectrum, and interleaved output allocations; checks every pair. Validation commands were intentionally not run.

zig.author: FftCell
zig.notes: Stdlib-only iterative radix-2 FFT with fixed input, complex spectrum, and interleaved output arrays; checks every pair. Validation commands were intentionally not run.

go.author: CardCloser-2
go.notes: Stdlib-only iterative radix-2 FFT over complex128, with a bits.Reverse64 permutation; allocates the input, spectrum and 8192-scalar interleaved output, then checks every pair.

node.author: FftCell
node.notes: Built-in Node iterative radix-2 FFT with explicit input, complex spectrum, and interleaved output allocations; checks every pair. Validation commands were intentionally not run.

lua.author: GoalsB-3
lua.notes: Stdlib-only iterative radix-2 FFT over parallel real and imaginary tables, with an arithmetic bit-reversal permutation (no bit library, so Lua 5.4 and LuaJIT run it unchanged); allocates the input, spectrum and 8192-scalar interleaved output, then checks every pair.
